scope: Two SIMD shared bodies, genuine compiled reconstructions and original-instruction differential tests
portable_test_type: Replay recorded original ARM64 results; does not emulate original machine code without the APK
limitations: Original Go authoring source is not recovered.
Original ARM64 index reads whole aligned blocks; safe Java/C index uses bounded reads.
Caller must supply valid readable/writable objects; C range checks cannot prove arbitrary pointer validity.
Original tested ISA is little-endian ARM64; C tested on macOS arm64 with NEON and scalar backends.
Checked argument failures are reconstruction API behavior, not original Go assembly exceptions.
No concurrent runtime, JNI or business invocation equivalence is claimed.
